    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row):
        if color==background: continue
        for r in range(h):
            cols=[c for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v==color]
            for a,b in zip(cols,cols[1:]):
                for c in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=3
        for c in range(w):
            rows=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]==color]
            for a,b in zip(rows,rows[1:]):
                for r in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=3
    return out
'''
